First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @pittsburghmajortaylor the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Major Taylor Cycling PGH Wednesday Ride group ride

A weekly no-drop tour around the city from OTB on the South Side, twelve to eighteen miles at a casual pace. Run by the local Major Taylor club, whose membership is open to all.
